info.title: ENROLLMENT API
info.description: This API facilitates the enrollment of individual members onto the Lynx platform for the desired product (HSA and/or Filtered Spend). Creates a member on the Lynx platform. This includes creation of the 'member' on Lynx, creation of a bank account and creation and distribution of cards (physical and/or virtual)

info.title: ENROLLMENT API
info.description: This API facilitates the enrollment of individual members onto the Lynx platform for the desired product (HSA and/or Filtered Spend). Creates a member on the Lynx platform. This includes creation of the 'member' on Lynx, creation of a bank account and creation and distribution of cards (physical and/or virtual)

post.description: The enrollment API is used to enroll a member with the Lynx platform. The API saves the member information within the Lynx platform and then proceeds to initiate various processes associated with the product(s) that the member is enrolling into. For example for a Health Savings Account, the API ensures creation of bank accounts and cards.

annualIncomeMin.description: Lower bound of the member's approximate annual income range. Number must be USD.

annualIncomeMax.description: Upper bound of the member's approximate annual income range. Number must be USD.

totalNetWorthMin.description: Lower bound of the member's total net worth range (assets minus liabilities). Assets include figures from checking, savings, and liquid securities, plus all liquid assets like a home and pension assets. Liabilities include money owed like mortgage payments, car loans, student loans, taxes, etc.

totalNetWorthMax.description: Upper bound of the member's total net worth range (assets minus liabilities).

netWorthLiquidMin.description: Lower bound of the member's liquid net worth range (in USD). Liquid net worth is the amount of cash or near cash equivalents that can be easily converted into cash and reinvested. Examples include money market holdings, exchange listed stocks, exchange-traded funds, mutual funds, etc.

netWorthLiquidMax.description: Upper bound of the member's liquid net worth range (in USD).

isControlPerson.description: Indicates whether the member is a Director, Officer, or 10% stock owner of a publicly traded company

isPoliticallyExposed.description: Indicates whether the member is a current or former politically exposed person or public official (includes US and Foreign). A politically exposed person is someone who has been entrusted with a prominent public function, or who is closely related to such a person.

isImmediateFamilyExposed.description: Indicates whether anyone in the member's immediate family is a current or former politically exposed person or public official (includes US and Foreign). A politically exposed person is someone who has been entrusted with a prominent public function, or who is closely related to such a person.

isBrokerDealerAffiliated.description: Indicates whether the member’s current employer is a broker/dealer
